synthesis.body: When generating an artifact from a source tree, split the work into a collate pass that emits one record per file with every awkward fact as a declared field, and a projection pass that consumes those records. Each exception (files that must not surface, path normalizations, override fields) becomes a visible field rather than a branch buried in projection logic, the before/after diff is computable so 'nothing regressed' is proven rather than asserted, and the two halves are testable independently.

title: Collate source material into a declared inventory before projecting it
